runsWhen: Each time the user sends a message, before the agent processes it.

inputs.name: prompt
inputs.description: The prompt text the user submitted. Treat it as untrusted user input.

outputs.name: modifiedPrompt
outputs.description: Replacement prompt the agent processes instead of what the user typed. Leave empty to keep the original.

outputs.name: suppressOutput
outputs.description: Set to true to hide this turn's output from the user.
